Signed-off-by: Yuxuan Ye <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR
Add test case about SSH Ciphers/Macs/Kexs and protocol version

Summary:
Fixes #3622

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

Add test case about SSH Ciphers/Macs/Kexs and protocol version.
- Ensure SSH protocol version 1.x is disabled
- Only preferred Ciphers/Mac/Kex should work without issues
    - Preferred Ciphers: ["<EMAIL>"], permitted Ciphers: ["aes256-ctr", "aes192-ctr"]
    - Preferred Macs: ['<EMAIL>'], Permitted Mac: ['<EMAIL>']
    - Preferred Kex: [ 'ecdh-sha2-nistp384'], Permitted Kex: [ 'ecdh-sha2-nistp521']

#### How did you do it?

- Check sshd version and check if sshd specially supports protocol version 1, because it's hard to guarantee that a ssh client support protocol version 1 will be found on test servers
- Positive test cases expect preferred/permitted ciphers to connect successfully
- Negative test cases expect the ciphers not preferred/permitted ciphers to fail to connect(Maybe this is not good?)

#### How did you verify/test it?

I changed the sshd config of KVM/DUT for several times, and tested the test case if it was working well
